priorityList: Cast Felblade with Inertia ready (Notes If Felblade isn't available, use Fel Rush instead)
Cast Immolation Aura if at 2 charges
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative (Notes Always try to align this with Eye Beam)
Cast Eye Beam / Abyssal Gaze (Notes Make sure you've consumed any Annihilation and Death Sweep procs)
Cast Essence Break while in Metamorphosis (Notes Aim to fill these 4 seconds with Death Sweep and Annihilation casts)
Cast Metamorphosis with Eye Beam, Immolation Aura and Death Sweep on cooldown
Cast Fel Rush with nothing else available
